note: The Conditional Access template library (DESIGN §5.1) as data. Converted from v1's CA-Scripts-Active by internal/tools/ConvertFrom-EpsV1CaTemplates.ps1 - do not edit by hand; change the converter or add a new template version. Every id is a role reference ({...}), never a tenant's value. EntraPolicySuite COMPARES a tenant's policies with these templates; the one write is a SuperAdmin's stage move of an adopted policy (CA-LIFECYCLE) - a template never writes a policy.

refs.{policyPilotGroup}: the policy's own pilot group (its name per group-targeting method is in the template's groups.pilot)
refs.{breakGlassAccounts}: every break-glass account (eps.BreakGlassAccount); :FIDO / :MFA = those with that authentication method
refs.{group:<VariableName>}: a v1 target group (eps.TargetGroup, Dynamic or Assigned by the group-targeting method)
refs.{namedLocation:DeniedCountries}: the named location of setting CA.DeniedCountriesLocationName
refs.{authStrength:FIDO}: the authentication strength of setting CA.AuthStrengthFidoName
refs.{authStrength:WHfB}: the authentication strength of setting CA.AuthStrengthWhfbName
